items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: he had this quartet that had Frank Wess on tenor saxophone... and of course Al Dunn on drums. During that time... I was sort of a supper club type place -- with a bandleader.

ctx.x: Yeah. Dick Wilson. Dick Wilson played a tenor saxophone solo on a thing called "Christopher Columbus." And Frank had just learned this solo, and so he came in that night and he asked me if I knew "I Got Rhythm." So I said, "Yeah." He said, "What key do you play it in." And I said I played it in C. He said, "I want you to play it in B-flat." I said, "I can't play it in B-flat."
